notes: «قال حميد أخبرنا عن الحسن» : «حميد» is a link (rule 5); the later «قال حميد» is his remark after the saying, not a link
The saying is Ibn Abbas's sermon as Hasan relates it, so Ibn Abbas is the last link (rule 6); Ali's later words are in the story
«- رحمه الله -» and «- رضى الله عنه -» are not part of any surface
